name: bookstore
description: Bookstore monorepo: Express/MongoDB API (apps/api) and React web app (apps/web)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/api ci && npm --prefix apps/web ci
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/api test && CI=true npm --prefix apps/web test -- --watchAll=false
scripts.down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml down
